name: fleet-review
description: Multi-AI code review for GitHub PRs with model scoring

fleetReview.defaultModels.description: Default AI models to use for code review

fleetReview.dataDir.description: Directory for review data and scores

fleetReview.geminiModel.description: Gemini model for code review. 'auto' lets Gemini CLI pick the best model (Gemini 3).

fleetReview.nanoGptApiKey.description: Nano-GPT API key for GLM model reviews. Get one at nano-gpt.com. Falls back to NANO_GPT_API_KEY env var.

fleetReview.timeoutSeconds.description: Default timeout in seconds for each model's review. Can be overridden per model via modelTimeouts.

fleetReview.diffSizeWarningThreshold.description: Warn before reviewing PRs with more changed lines than this threshold.

node.description: Custom audit prompt for Node.js projects

rust.description: Custom audit prompt for Rust projects

go.description: Custom audit prompt for Go projects

python.description: Custom audit prompt for Python projects

jvm.description: Custom audit prompt for JVM projects

android.description: Custom audit prompt for Android projects

ruby.description: Custom audit prompt for Ruby projects

fleetReview.projectPrompts.description: Custom review prompts per project type. Overrides the default audit instructions for the detected project type. Use this to focus reviews on what matters most for your stack (e.g., memory safety for Rust, async handling for Node).

node.description: Extra hints appended for Node.js projects

rust.description: Extra hints appended for Rust projects

go.description: Extra hints appended for Go projects

python.description: Extra hints appended for Python projects

jvm.description: Extra hints appended for JVM projects

android.description: Extra hints appended for Android projects

ruby.description: Extra hints appended for Ruby projects

fleetReview.projectHints.description: Extra hints appended to the default project-type hints. Use to add project-specific review focus areas without replacing the entire prompt.

fleetReview.modelTimeouts.description: Per-model timeout overrides in seconds. Models not listed here use the default timeoutSeconds.
